note: These were failed pre-finish harness/validation attempts. They are retained alongside the successful run; no failed attempt produced result rows or changed a strategy outcome.

attempts.root_cause: Reused evaluator imports kernel by module name; its directory was not on sys.path.
attempts.correction: Added the existing engine directory to sys.path, matching the working prior-round loader; minimal import probe confirmed access to fill and lagged_cost_inputs.

attempts.error: AssertionError: prior five-minute VWAP input availability at first daily row
attempts.root_cause: A negative slice at dataset index zero wrapped to the tail, so the causal-availability assertion correctly detected future bars.
attempts.correction: At the data origin where five prior minute bars do not exist, store zero proxy VWAP; no strategy signal or transaction cost is evaluated until complete lagged history exists. OOS begins at daily index 368.

attempts.error: NameError: hashlib was not imported in the Markdown/SVG writer.
attempts.root_cause: Presentation helper lacked a standard-library import.
attempts.correction: Added hashlib and reran result.md/SVG generation successfully.

attempts.error: Decimal reference-wealth check differed by 1.29e-25 on a filled BTC/ETH order.
attempts.root_cause: Audit compared independently summed Decimal cost components with exact equality; the fill kernel itself allows rounding tolerance 1e-20.
attempts.correction: Use 1e-20 absolute tolerance, then all 26 configs / 78 scenes passed independent balance, cost, signal, fold and NAV checks.

attempts.stage: replay invoked while rows were reserved
attempts.error: Replay command requires each fingerprint to be passed/rejected; current rows were still reserved.
attempts.root_cause: Replay mode intentionally refuses to run before finish, preventing accidental duplicate work on an active configuration.
attempts.correction: Complete independent audit and finish the actual results first; exact replay then runs in the normal post-finish lifecycle.
